VIXL / A DESIGN ENGINE FOR AI AGENTS

Programmable. Editable. Checked.

MCP · CLI · Python · REST

Vixl is a design engine for AI agents. Your agent builds graphics, documents and motion out of real layers, Vixl checks the work, and you get a file you can still change next week. Fun fact: this deck was made with Vixl.

Not a picture. A document.

History

Text, paths, images, masks and effects. All still editable.

Groups, variables, pages, layouts and reusable parts.

Undo, checkpoints, branches and diffs. Go back in time.

Ask for a poster and most tools hand you a picture of a poster. The .vixl master keeps the content, settings and branching history instead. Raster images stay pixels; text, supported shapes and paths stay editable. Send the master along with whatever formats people asked for.

Look before you export.

THE AGENT LOOP

Inspect

Check

Preview

Export

Read the canvas. Make atomic edits. Run the checks.

Look at the render. Then ship the files.

Inspect, apply, check, preview and export. Each step tells the agent what went wrong while it is still cheap to fix. The diagram is Vixl's own diagram operation: editable nodes, routed paths and text. Checks back up visual review; they do not judge taste.

From print to pixels.

Illustrative workflow data, not a customer result or performance claim. Vixl binds the chart to categories and series, so new numbers do not mean a new chart. In the PowerPoint export it is a native chart with an embedded workbook: open Edit Data and poke around.

One recipe. Plenty of posts.

CREATIVE AUTOMATION

Typed inputs + variables

Text fitting + saved checks

CSV-driven batches

Reusable containers and templates

The included social campaign is a typed recipe: headline, description and accent go in, posts come out. Production fills in three CSV rows, runs the saved design suite and exports only the variants that pass. Nobody copies and pastes anything. Start from the supplied CSV and production request.

Make it move. Ship the states.

Keyframes, motion recipes, posable characters, cameras and audio.

GIF, animated WebP, APNG, MP4 and other timeline formats.

App states, theme variables, transitions and reduced-motion stills.

Vixl has timeline tracks, cameras, audio and rigged joint pose keys. The app demo in this kit ships ready, creating and delivered states with light and dark themes, explicit transitions, editable masters and reduced-motion PNGs. The teaser is an editable timeline exported to MP4 and GIF.

Write the brief as tests.

CHECKED BEFORE IT SHIPS

01

02

03

Define

Inspect

Share

Turn margins, contrast and hierarchy into saved suites.

Run the checks, read the findings, then actually look.

Offline proof pages or a live REST review session.

Design checks cover bounds, flow, contrast, fonts and more. Saved suites turn margins, hierarchy and spacing into rules that pass or fail. Proof pages collect previews and findings offline. A passing check proves its rules, not your taste, so someone still looks at the render.

Designs get code review too.

REVIEWABLE WORK

01

02

03

Git review

Shared work

Portable files

Readable JSON + assets through pack and unpack.

Branches, explicit merges, project groups and shared libraries.

Fonts and content travel inside the editable master.

Unpack a .vixl master into stable JSON and hashed assets, review the diff in Git, then pack it back into a document. Branching history, project groups and reusable libraries cover the rest of teamwork. The included campaign has an unpacked source folder you can browse.

Same operations. Your tools.

MCP serves agents, the CLI serves scripts and CI, Python serves generators and notebooks, and REST serves integrations and live review. All share canonical operations. The server extra is needed for REST.

Whatever format they asked for.

A COMPLETE HANDOFF

01

02

03

Screen

Documents

Print + motion

PNG, JPEG, WebP, SVG and icons.

PDF, fillable PDF, PPTX and HTML decks.

CMYK PDF/TIFF, GIF, WebP, MP4 and more.

Supported vectors stay vector in SVG/PDF where possible; some features use reported raster fallbacks. PPTX preserves supported editable shapes, text, tables and charts. PSD export is layered pixels, not native editable type. CMYK is an export setting; ask your printer to confirm the profile.

Give your agent real layers.

YOUR TURN

terminal

git clone https://github.com/jxburros/Vixl.git

cd Vixl

python -m pip install -e '.[server,pdf]'

vixl mcp --workspace . --tools core --schema slim

Windows installer: GitHub Releases

github.com/jxburros/Vixl

Source-available · PolyForm Small Business 1.0.0

AI features use configured external providers.

Windows users can use the installer from GitHub Releases. Developers need Python 3.11 or newer; clone the repo, then install its extras. Run the MCP command in an existing workspace. Vixl is source-available under PolyForm Small Business 1.0.0; read LICENSE for eligibility. Core authoring works locally. AI generation and vision need configured external providers.
